name_note: GTDB places this species in the genus Oliverpabstia, while the literature and the NCBI records of its genomes use the name Blautia faecicola.

sentences.text: Blautia faecicola was proposed as a novel species for strain KGMB01111, an obligately anaerobic, Gram-stain-positive, non-motile, coccoid- or oval-shaped bacterium isolated from faeces of a healthy Korean.
The description places the strain within the family Lachnospiraceae and reports acetic acid as the predominant end product of its fermentation.
In a study of gut mucosal biopsies, participants with low-grade dysplasia polyps in the distal colon showed more amplicons from Blautia faecicola.
A randomized placebo-controlled trial in people with Parkinson's disease and constipation reported enrichment of Blautia faecicola in the probiotic group compared with placebo.
